film: How a Flattened City Grew Back
film_cn: 被炸平的城市怎样长回来
line: A projector paints Rotterdam's white model layer by layer, from the 1940 gap to today's towers.
line_cn: 投影机把数据一层层刷上鹿特丹白模：从 1940 年的空洞到今天的塔楼。

camera.move: Macro glide at rooftop height, shallow focus
camera.expresses: the model is a real object
camera.serves: an opening; a detail that matters

camera.expresses: the whole pattern only seen from above
camera.serves: revealing a hole, a cluster, an edge

camera.expresses: the city as a whole, layers accumulating
camera.serves: growth over time; comparisons across the model

camera.move: Boom down to a low angle against black
camera.serves: tall buildings, heights, a single tower

camera.expresses: a measured distance on the model
camera.serves: a shadow, a corridor, a route, a view line

camera.move: Pull back as the house lights return
camera.expresses: the data stops; the object remains
camera.serves: an ending; a reset between topics

transitions: Transitions are light changes on one take (lights out, a layer replacing another, the projector going dark), not cuts, fades or wipes.
labels: Roles: a light grotesk for the figure (Inter Tight 200, 120–140 px), a sans for labels in the film's language (Noto Sans SC 300/500, 20–36 px), a monospace for instruments, years and coordinates (IBM Plex Mono, 18–22 px). OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset.
Readout in the left third, one per layer: index + layer name, one figure, one label, one source line, a legend bar.
Pins: a hairline from a roof or a ground point up to a tag on a dark plate (title 26 px + one sub line 20 px).
Identity label top-left, quiet: place, scale, data sources.
motion: The camera moves continuously and slowly; it changes speed with the layers, never stops dead.

Light is the actor. Each layer arrives by a soft-edged gesture of light: a wash spreading from the projector axis, buildings switching on one by one with a short flash, a level climbing every facade, the sun's clock running. No hard line sweeping the table.
House lights cut fast (a relay, 0.25 s) and return slowly (1 s); the projector strikes with a brief flicker.
Counters roll while the light moves and land when it lands; measured lines grow from A to B with ticks.

native_moves.name: Lights out, lamp on
native_moves.does: House light, a relay, darkness, the lamp strikes, the first layer arrives.
native_moves.fits: a site before and after; a district before a plan is shown; any "now look closer".

native_moves.name: The hole
native_moves.does: Light only the set that answers a question (built before a date, owned by one party, inside a zone) and let the absence draw the shape.
native_moves.fits: a war-damaged centre; a flood plain with no housing; land a company owns; a protected zone.

native_moves.name: Layers by time
native_moves.does: Buildings switch on in the decade they were built, each layer faster than the last, a year counter rolling.
native_moves.fits: a new town's growth; a campus master plan by phase; a port's expansion; a developer's portfolio by year.

native_moves.name: The rising level
native_moves.does: A soft level of light climbs every facade at once; low buildings finish first, the tallest last, the reading rides up with it.
native_moves.fits: building heights; sea-level or flood depth; floor counts; a height limit being tested.

native_moves.name: The sun clock
native_moves.does: A real sun at a real date sweeps the shadows; the projector then traces one shadow and measures it.
native_moves.fits: a new tower's shadow on a park; winter light in a courtyard; solar panels' best roofs; a street's daylight hours.

native_moves.name: The pick-out
native_moves.does: One building or set lights alone while the rest stay dark, with a pin.
native_moves.fits: a listed building; the plot for sale; the hospital in an evacuation plan.

native_moves.name: Lights up
native_moves.does: The data stops, the white model comes back. An ending or a reset.

score.note: mallets and glass for light, bowed vibraphone, timpani and low brass for weight
